C9000203.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 203 (Donovan's conjecture over fields and complete mixed-characteristic DVRs.; papers: Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields; Integral Donovan Finiteness over Witt Vectors; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PUBLISHABLE_AUDIT_ADVANCE.statement: A substantive new exact refutation, repaired theorem or structural verification theorem for the manuscript family is independently justified; known-result reconstruction and finite route diagnostics alone do not satisfy this campaign goal.

C_FIELD_DONOVAN.statement: Field manuscript thm:donovan: bounded-defect Morita finiteness over every fixed algebraically closed characteristic-p field.

C_INTEGRAL_DONOVAN.statement: Integral manuscript thm:main: bounded-defect Morita finiteness over W(Fpbar).

C_INTEGRAL_DVR.statement: Integral manuscript cor:complete-dvr: bounded-defect Morita finiteness over each fixed complete mixed-characteristic DVR with algebraically closed residue field.

C_SINGLE_CYCLE_TRANSPORT.statement: Field prop:single-cycle: A = epsilon B for the fixed rational parameter and all individual Jordan labels.

C_KNOWN_CLASSICAL_TRANSPORT.statement: Enguehard Proposition 5.3 gives the prior classical connected-center transport theorem, assuming Mackey.

C_UNIVERSAL_DESCENT_ALGEBRA.statement: The nineteen recorded descent, inverse-transpose, and parameter-quotient word identities hold in arbitrary groups and for invertible matrices of every size.

C_D4_RATIONAL_DIAGNOSTIC.statement: The specified graph-twisted D4 Weyl datum has a stable double position of size 144 with no F-fixed representative; its specified centralizer subsystem has no stable disjoint double position.

L_SINGLE_CYCLE_MINIMUM.statement: Field lab:sparse: each predicted family row is the unique integral minimum-norm row with its uniform pairings, including individual split D boundary labels.

L_SINGLE_CYCLE_RATIONAL_MATCH.statement: The dual rational Mackey matching is choice-independent and preserves both embeddings, Frobenius maps and rational semisimple refinements.

L_SINGLE_CYCLE_TERM_COMPARE.statement: All matched trace contributions agree by equal/disjoint support induction with individual split labels.

L_SINGLE_CYCLE_NORM.statement: The projected ambient and unipotent centralizer self-Mackey traces, hence squared Hilbert-Schmidt norms, agree.

L_CLASSICAL_MACKEY.statement: Bonnafe--Michel Theorem 3.8(4) supplies Mackey for all classical components, including q=2.

L_JORDAN_MARKED_EQUIVARIANCE.statement: The ordinary Jordan torus rule and marked isomorphism equivariance distinguish individual classical labels.

L_CONNECTED_LANG_DESCENT.statement: Connected algebraic intersection stabilizers give the claimed rational double-orbit descent; local dual lattice constructions globalize independently of auxiliary tori.

L_RATIONAL_PARAMETER_QUOTIENT.statement: The two-endpoint parameter-refined quotient identifies with the centralizer double quotient with both embeddings retained.

L_CYCLE_SUPPORT_GEOMETRY.statement: Admissible rational common-torus supports are equal or disjoint, with unique primitive subtorus on equal support, in all allowed packets.

L_QUASISIMPLE_CARTAN.statement: Field thm:quasisimple-cartan: bounded-defect Cartan entries are uniformly bounded in all quasisimple groups.

L_RUNNER_REDUCTION.statement: Field runner reduction controls projective cones along the prescribed moves.

L_BLOCK_CORE_PROJECTIONS.statement: Field prop:core-blocks identifies the required packed-core collections with block-idempotent projections.

L_RUNNER_CONE_ESTIMATES.statement: The runner permutation/error, determinant and volume estimates give the claimed uniform cone bounds.

L_CUSPIDAL_ENDPOINT.statement: Field prop:triangle-cartan controls cuspidal triangles uniformly in their rank.

L_ENDPOINT_HEAD_COVER.statement: The modular endpoint intertwiners, obstruction removal and head coverage hold as stated.

L_FIELD_EXTENSIONS.statement: The field crossed-extension comparison and descent retain Sylow actions and actual inner factors and imply finiteness.

L_FIELD_SCALAR_EXTENSION.statement: The finite list over Fpbar extends to each fixed algebraically closed characteristic-p field without changing defect.

L_INTEGRAL_EXACT_COMPARISON.statement: The integral comparison removes the actual Teichmuller-valued scalar errors while retaining the specified multiplication factors.

L_INTEGRAL_BASED_FINITE.statement: Integral rigidity and actual Sylow extension blocks yield finite based lists of restrictions.

L_INTEGRAL_KERNEL_REMOVAL.statement: Removal of the large normal prime-to-p kernel preserves based control and gives finite integral central factor systems.

L_INTEGRAL_SCALAR_EXTENSION.statement: The finite Witt-ring Morita list extends to each fixed complete coefficient DVR in the stated corollary.
